name: The Smear (Cross-Tier Viral Graffiti Movement)
description: The Smear began as a single image — a long horizontal streak of mixed pigment, thumb-width, applied at eye level — left by an unknown hand across the front door of a Halverson-Osei subsidiary office in Tier 3 in 2219. Within six months, identical marks had appeared in all five tiers, including one famously discovered on the interior wall of a Spire executive residence that had been locked and surveilled for three years. The Smear has no confirmed creator, no manifesto, and no discernible agenda beyond presence — its practitioners, called Smearers, leave the mark on corporate property exclusively, always at precisely eye level, always a single unbroken horizontal motion. Art critics and corp-sec analysts alike have failed to agree on whether it is coordinated protest, spontaneous mimicry, or something stranger.
cultural_impact: The Smear has become GLMZ's most debated urban symbol — reproduced on merchandise, analyzed in academic papers, and used as a rallying image by at least four unrelated political movements, none of which can claim ownership of it.
key_figures: Theodora Abara-Kowalczyk (art critic who first documented the phenomenon)
The Unsmeared (corp-sec task force assigned to the case)
locations: Halverson-Osei subsidiary office, Tier 3 (first documented site)
The Smear Wall — a Shelf alley in Sector 4 covered entirely in collected documentation
story_hooks: Corp-sec hires a fixer to identify and neutralize the Smear's originator — but the investigation leads to evidence that the first mark appeared simultaneously in three locations on the same night, physically impossible for a single person.
A Smearer contacts the players claiming they know who started it and that the original creator is now in danger — from the very movement they spawned.
An E.L.F. in the Underworld claims to have identified a mathematical pattern in the Smear's placement across GLMZ that spells something, and it wants help understanding what.
related_entities: NeuralPath CivID Plus Identity & Payment BCI
